title: agent-workflows trigger (protocol 0.1)
description: Validates a `metadata.workflow` block that declares a workflow entry point's trigger (spec section 9.3). kind defaults to manual; every and cron are each valid only for their own kind and never together. Sibling structures and unknown keys are tolerated per the 0.x degradation rules (spec section 9.4).

kind.description: How the workflow starts; manual is the default and preserves on-demand behavior (spec section 9.3).

every.description: interval kind only: the run cadence, matched to the real change rate of the watched input (spec section 9.3).

cron.description: cron kind only: a cron expression, e.g. "0 9 * * 1" (spec section 9.3).

until.description: Stop condition for recurring runs: stops when the command's output equals the value (spec section 9.3).

oneOf.description: interval kind: every required, cron forbidden (spec section 9.3).
cron kind: cron required, every forbidden (spec section 9.3).
manual (default when kind is omitted) or event kind: neither every nor cron (spec section 9.3).

protocol.description: Protocol version this block was authored against, `<major>.<minor>` (spec sections 9 and 11).
